window.classification: exhausted old tuning year, NOT new OOS

warmup.rule: source checks history length BEFORE append; compare indices >=120

method.calendar: distinct dates present in each tick input within the fixed window
method.pairing: inner join on UTC minute; BOTH arms use tick BID OHLC; only n changes
method.tick_volume: n is the count of accepted ticks from original aggregate_1m
method.vendor_volume: native BID candle volume; decode_day round(volume, 2); float, not count
method.indicators: last120 close-weighted VWAP, all-zero volume falls back to SMA; EMA uses source _ema(last9,9); never read _prev_vwap
method.signals: independent TraderDevEMA9VWAP.update_bar instances; position property after each bar, including flat exits; no fills or performance calculation
method.ema_side: exact three-way sign(EMA - instantaneous VWAP), no threshold
method.quantiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; undefined statistics are null
method.cache: validated raw columnar JSON; per-day SHA256 manifests; max4 bounded batches
method.failure: empty vendor day with tick data or malformed/unavailable day aborts; failure report is incomplete and cannot stand in for a comparison

exclusions: unmatched minutes from both arms, never filled
first120 4h bars excluded only from sensitivity summaries
dates absent from tick inputs are not requested
no returns, Sharpe, evaluation, materiality verdict, or promotion

vwap_difference_pips.sign: vendor minus tick; quantiles are absolute
vendor minus tick; quantiles are absolute
